native_dense.scope: One-dimensional field varying along z. All axes periodic. Uniform off-diagonal tensor; both principal waves excited. This checks the native update independently of source, PML and curved-ring geometry.
native_dense.oracle: Leapfrog Yee recurrence with analytic normal/tangential eigenvalues, E initially cos(kz) on x and H initially zero.
